findings.desc: [HIGH] packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts:214 The project-local-bin drift check is inverted. `shadowsEntrypoint` is set when `node_modules/.bin/koala` resolves to the same realpath as the active CLI, so doctor warns on the safe case and passes when the local bin points somewhere else. This breaks runtime scanner correctness and creates both false positives and false negatives for the exact drift this fact is meant to catch. Fix by treating differing realpaths as drift when both paths resolve, and identical targets as pass.

[MEDIUM] packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts:419,428,460,514,527,537,545 New bare silent catches were added without the required DEBUG/PROBE/PERSIST/MUTATION classification from AGENTS.md. These branches swallow directory reads, stat failures, command execution failures, package parsing, text reads, directory scans, and realpath resolution with no annotation or health reporting, which makes runtime-scan diagnosis harder and violates the project fail-fast contract. Fix by marking benign probe/debug catches inline and routing persist/mutation failures through `reportHealthIssue(...)` or `throw` as the policy requires.
